title: SCHC 22,554-byte ceiling is applied to raw IPv6 instead of encoded SCHC packets
description: Correctness review of python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py found validate_full_ipv6 permits a 22,554-byte raw IPv6 packet and encode_rule255 then prepends Rule ID 255, producing a 22,555-byte SCHC Packet that FragmentSender correctly rejects. Conversely compressible packets whose raw IPv6 is slightly above 22,554 but whose encoded SCHC packet is within the 22,554-byte fragmentation ceiling are rejected early. spec/03-adaptation.md §5.6 and the SCHC draft define 22,554 as the SCHC Packet encoding/reassembly ceiling (126*179), with 1,281 explicitly meaning 1-byte Rule ID + 1,280-byte IPv6. Enforce limits on the final encoded/input SCHC packet, make Rule 255's maximum raw IPv6 length 22,553, and add exact max/max+1 tests for Rule 255 and compressed Rule 7/generic rules without conflating raw and compressed sizes.
